env.scratch: SCR = the migrate run's scratch dir; D = docs/e2e/milestone-rev6-p3-physics
env.service: UNMAPPED_SERVICE_TEST=1 bun run service -- --port 8800 --data $SCR/physics/svc   (fresh data dir; health: physics [1], protocol 2, test true)
env.probe: bun run world:probe -- --service ws://127.0.0.1:8800 physics   (output: probe.out.txt)
env.backups: bun --tsconfig-override tsconfig.node.json $D/craft-physics2.ts.txt $SCR/backup/files/b1.spire-backup $SCR/physics/files   (makes pin2.spire-backup and genesis2.spire-backup from the backup run's B1; the genesis2 world is signed by a throwaway key made in memory)
env.app: AETHER_TEST_BACKUP_PATH=$SCR/physics/files/io.spire-backup OPENAI_API_KEY= THESYS_API_KEY= AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/physics/udP bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9352   (udP: empty + inference.json pointing at a dead llama.cpp endpoint, 127.0.0.1:8859)
env.driver: CDP_PORT=9352 bun scripts/cdp-drive.ts "$(cat $D/run.json)"   (copy the backup to import onto io.spire-backup before each Restore, see the notes)
env.build: main 51817a3 plus the uncommitted working tree of every session, with this session's planner fix

sequence: shell: start the service on 8800; run the probe's physics scenario
shell: craft the two physics-2 backups; cp genesis2.spire-backup io.spire-backup; launch the app
run.json: Restore backup (genesis2) → refused; cp pin2 → io, Restore → refused; cp B1 → io, Restore → restored (control)
shell: close the app; stop the service (SIGTERM)

actions.eval: (async () => { const r = await window.seed.instances.importBackup(); return r.ok ? { ok: true } : r.error })()
